channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Australian Dollar struggles against softer US Dollar amid geopolitical uncertainty
item.description: AUD/USD remains subdued for the second successive day, trading around 0.6890 during the European hours on Monday. The pair is consolidating its recent losses as a subdued Australian Dollar (AUD) battles a softer US Dollar (USD) amid persistent geopolitical uncertainty.

item.title: Euro: Sintra tone and CPI support gains against US Dollar – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole expects the European Central Bank’s Sintra forum to maintain a broadly hawkish stance, with President Lagarde unlikely to signal a dovish shift ahead of June CPI.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Consolidates after sharp fall against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang notes AUD/USD remains locked in a short-term range between 0.6880 and 0.6920 after a recent impulsive decline. Downward momentum is starting to ease, with a break above 0.6940 seen as signalling that the major 0.6835 support is out of reach.

item.title: Brent Oil: Conflict risks ease but remain – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank Research’s Jim Reid and team highlight that Brent Oil fell sharply last week as traffic through the Strait of Hormuz increased, easing inflation concerns and rate-hike fears.

item.title: ECB: Sintra signals and sticky hike premium – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Guntermann highlights the Sintra forum as a key event for European Central Bank (ECB) communication, with Lagarde’s opening speech and a heavyweight policy panel midweek.

item.title: Dow Jones futures rise on easing Middle East tensions
item.description: US index futures advance during European trading hours on Monday as market sentiment rebounded on signs of easing geopolitical tensions. The Dow Jones futures gain 0.33% to trade near 52,400, while S&P 500 futures climbed 0.65% to around 7,450.

item.title: Asia FX: Defensive stance as US rates stay high – MUFG
item.description: Lloyd Chan at MUFG notes broad depreciation across Asia FX since the June FOMC meeting, driven by widening swap differentials and sustained high US rates. The bank keeps a defensive bias on selective Asia currencies.

item.title: ECB’s Kazāks: The possibility of negative scenarios has fallen massively
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member Mārtiņš Kazāks said during the European trading session on Monday that the possibility of negative scenarios in the Eurozone has fallen massively.

item.title: British Pound: Sterling resilient but Euro cross supported – ING
item.description: Francesco Pesole at ING highlights the Pound’s resilience despite shifting expectations around the next United Kingdom (UK) Chancellor, with markets seemingly relaxed about fiscal risks.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Holds near multi-year lows against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang sees USD/JPY continuing to consolidate just below the 2024 high of 162.00, with intraday trading expected between 161.45 and 161.95.

item.title: United States Dollar Index declines as US-Iran attacks halt
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, continues its losing streak for the third consecutive day and is trading around 101.20 during the European hours on Monday.

item.title: S&P 500: Tech-led correction after chip rout – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank Research reports that the S&P 500 and Nasdaq fell last week in a global tech sell-off, with the Magnificent 7 entering correction territory. Chipmakers led the weakness as the Philly Semiconductor Index slumped despite Micron’s revenue beat.

item.title: Indian Rupee flattens while focus shifts to US-Iran talks in Oman
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades flat against the US Dollar (USD) after a long weekend on Monday.

item.title: Indian Rupee: Lower oil prices supports against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Charlie Lay and Dr. Henry Hao note that the outlook for the Indian Rupee (INR) has brightened as lower Oil prices and renewed foreign capital inflows ease balance-of-payments pressures.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Holds losses below 1.4200 within overbought zone
item.description: USD/CAD loses ground for the third successive day, trading around 1.4180 during the early European hours on Monday. The pair continues its losing streak after pulling back from 14-month highs.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Remains sideways below 162.00 despite Japan intervention fears
item.description: The USD/JPY pair trades in a tight range around 161.80 during the European trading session on Monday. The pair struggles for a direction while market experts remain confident of Tokyo’s intervention to support the Japanese Yen (JPY).

item.title: Oil: downside momentum persists as risks linger – ING
item.description: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Oil has posted only modest gains despite renewed US–Iran tensions and elevated risks in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: WTI falls below $70.00 on US-Iran ceasefire talks uncertainty
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $69.80 during the early European trading hours on Monday. The WTI price declines amid uncertainty surrounding US-Iran talks.

item.title: Forex Today: Cautious start to week as markets assess latest on US-Iran conflict
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Monday, June 29:

item.title: US Dollar: Supported with elevated real yields – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lloyd Chan highlights that US Treasury yields have eased only slightly, leaving the broader rates backdrop supportive for the Dollar. Elevated real yields and a “high-for-longer” US rate narrative keep USD demand firm and Asia FX under pressure.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Pound keeps looking for direction around 1.3200
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) is practically flat against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday, with Pound bulls subdued amid rising geopolitical tensions and the UK’s political impasse, while the safe-haven USD treads water, awaiting an array of US employment indicators.

item.title: British Pound: Pound capped as bearish bias lingers against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang highlights that GBP/USD continues to lack clear momentum, with intraday action expected between 1.3175 and 1.3225. The bank maintains a negative 1–3 week view, seeing scope for a drop toward 1.3110 while strong resistance at 1.3245 caps upside.

item.title: Euro: Higher levels seen as slow grind against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Michael Pfister argues that recent EUR/USD weakness reflects Dollar strength rather than Euro fragility, with Fed expectations driving the move.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD declines to near $58.60 as US-Iran attacks renew energy supply concerns
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) trades almost 1% lower at around $58.60 during the European trading session on Monday. The white metal is under pressure as trade of attacks between the United States (US) and Iran has renewed fears of energy flow disruption, a scenario that could boost oil prices.

item.title: Gold slumps to near $4,050 as US-Iran talks uncertainty triggers inflation fears
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) remains under selling pressure around $4,060 during the early European trading hours on Monday. The precious metal falls amid uncertainty surrounding US-Iran talks and hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) expectations.

item.title: Euro posts modest losses against British Pound ahead of ECB’s annual forum
item.description: The EUR/GBP cross loses ground to near 0.8625 during the early European trading hours on Monday. Fading additional rate hike expectations from the European Central Bank (ECB) weigh on the Euro (EUR) against the British Pound (GBP). Traders will closely watch the ECB’s annual forum later on Monday.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah loses ground on Middle East uncertainty
item.description: USD/IDR gains ground after two days of losses, trading around 17,900 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: Euro steadies below 1.1400, Lagarde speech in spotlight
item.description: The EUR/USD pair holds steady near 1.1385 during the early European trading hours on Monday. Traders continue to assess the developments surrounding talks to end the US war with Iran.

item.title: Swiss Franc steadies against US Dollar amid market caution
item.description: USD/CHF remains flat for the second successive day, hovering around 0.8100 during the Asian hours on Monday. The pair moves little as the US Dollar (USD) remains calm amid market caution following the latest military clashes between the United States (US) and Iran and its temporary truce.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Monday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.
